name: Price tag
what: A sale: a card pops up, the old price gets struck through, the new price slams in, a spiky -50 % burst spins onto the corner and keeps turning, confetti falls once, a button pops and pulses.
origin: product promos and sale badges - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: card 14 f (back.out); strike 6 f; price 1.6 -> 1 in 8 f + a 3 f shake; burst back.out 12 f then turns; confetti once; button pops, pulses every 30 f
